text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hold up, Ace. Come hang out with me today. 
...It's your birthday, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Whoa, you remembered!? Thanks a bunch!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Still, sorry! My schedule's packed after 
this! CB and Rudolf both called for me, 
too...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
That's why I won't let ya pass. Not until 
you say, "I'll spend time with you guys."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Or is it that unless I become a favorite, 
I cannot even receive your love?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
It's your birthday. Rather than the same 
old taste on repeat, you should dig into a 
special cake instead.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
If we settle this right now, I'll give you 
a reward so sweet it'll make you sick to 
your stomach. You're not gonna... run away 
like a coward, are you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Fierce, wonderful love blooms as well. 
...Right?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Got it! I'll go ask C.B. and the others to 
race with us!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I mean... haha! If you wanted to run that 
badly, you should've just said so! I'll 
take you on as many times as you want, got 
it?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Alright, see ya in a bit. Okay?
